products.subtitle: 41.0 x 35.0 mm Ultra Low Power Atomic Oscillator (CSAC)
highlights: Introducing the TAITIEN DTA-450, a revolutionary Chip Scale Atomic Clock that redefines precision in portable formats. Consuming less than 130 mW and sized at a mere 17 cc, this compact marvel brings atomic clock accuracy to your fingertips. With its 10 MHz CMOS-compatible output, the DTA-450 seamlessly integrates into diverse applications, from satellite timing to advanced communication systems. Its standout feature, a 1PPS output/input, ensures synchronization accuracy within ±50 nanoseconds, making it a cornerstone in precision timekeeping. Engineered for resilience, the DTA-450 operates flawlessly across extreme temperatures, maintaining stability with minimal long-term aging. Additionally, its RS-232 interface offers sophisticated control, ensuring peak performance. Ideal for a wide range of critical applications, including GPS receivers and autonomous networks, the DTA-450 adheres to RoHS standards, aligning cutting-edge technology with environmental responsibility. Choose TAITIEN’s DT-450 for unmatched precision and reliability in your timekeeping needs.

highlights: Taitien Electronics’ NP-100M-7000 is a 100 MHz Ultra Low Power (VC)OCXO that delivers high-frequency sine wave output with exceptional phase noise performance and minimal power consumption.
